title: assign_guardian
description: Assign a guardian/sponsor to a subject entity. Subject callers can self-assign (legacy student_id inferred from caller). Reviewers and domain authorities must provide both IDs. Supports multiple guardians per subject.

guardian_id.description: User ID or display name of the guardian.

student_id.description: Legacy field name for subject ID. Optional for self-service callers (defaults to self), required for reviewer/DA callers.
